industry_module_recommendations.title: Find the Right Modules for Your Industry
industry_module_recommendations.subtitle: Select your industry to see the modules most commonly used by businesses like yours.

industries.label: Importers
industries.summary: Most importers use InventoryIQ, PurchaseIQ, ImportIQ, ForecastIQ, AccountingIQ, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to manage stock, purchasing, landed costs, payroll and document capture.

industries.label: Distributors
industries.summary: Most distributors use InventoryIQ, PurchaseIQ, ForecastIQ, DeliveryIQ, AccountingIQ, Trade Portal, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to keep replenishment, customer ordering, delivery, finance, payroll and capture workflows connected.

industries.label: Manufacturers
industries.summary: Most manufacturers use InventoryIQ, ManufacturingIQ, PurchaseIQ, ForecastIQ, AccountingIQ, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to plan materials, production, labour, cost control and document capture.

industries.label: Multi-Branch Businesses
industries.summary: Most multi-branch businesses use InventoryIQ, PurchaseIQ, ForecastIQ, DeliveryIQ, AccountingIQ, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to control stock, demand, payroll, capture and branch accountability.

industries.label: Retail & POS
industries.summary: Most retail and POS teams use InventoryIQ, ForecastIQ, AccountingIQ, BankingIQ, SlipsIQ, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to connect tills, stock, cash controls, payroll and slip capture.

industries.label: Wholesalers
industries.summary: Most wholesalers use InventoryIQ, PurchaseIQ, ForecastIQ, DeliveryIQ, AccountingIQ, Trade Portal, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to manage customer ordering, volume sales, stock availability, deliveries, payroll and documents.

industries.label: Service Businesses
industries.summary: Most service businesses use TaskIQ, InvoiceIQ, AccountingIQ, BankingIQ, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to keep work, billing, payroll, payments and document capture in one place.

industries.label: Ecommerce
industries.summary: Most ecommerce teams use InventoryIQ, PurchaseIQ, ForecastIQ, AccountingIQ, DeliveryIQ, PayrollIQ and AI Automation Suite to connect online demand to stock, purchasing, fulfilment, payroll and capture.

starter_lite.name: Starter Lite
starter_lite.tagline: Start simple. Scale without changing systems.

extra_users.name: Extra User Seat
extra_users.description: Add one additional team member without forcing a full plan upgrade.
value_points: Keeps daily users inside the same live workspace
Useful when operations teams grow before SKU or warehouse limits do

extra_skus.name: Extra SKU Capacity
value_points: Keeps inventory, costing, purchasing, and sales history in one system
Buys more catalogue headroom without paying for unused warehouses

agentsiq_usage_pack.name: AI Pack
agentsiq_usage_pack.description: AI Pack: 100 capture credits shared with AI Automation Suite capture and AgentsIQ workflows
value_points: Recurring monthly AI credit allowance for capture and agent usage
Lets customers scale AI usage in small, predictable increments

workiq_addon.name: WorkIQ Add-on
workiq_addon.description: WorkIQ job cards, work queues, and execution tracking.
value_points: Turns operational work into assignable job cards
Keeps execution queues visible alongside customers, invoices, and stock

ai_auto_capture.name: AI Automation Suite
ai_auto_capture.description: AI Automation Suite for document capture, slip capture, import capture, SalesIQ voice transcription, and AgentsIQ proactive workflows with 150 monthly capture credits.
value_points: Turns invoices, purchase orders, supplier bills, slips, import documents, and voice notes into review-ready drafts
Includes AgentsIQ proactive checks and follow-up workflows while preserving human review before posting or action

jobiq_addon.name: JobIQ
jobiq_addon.description: Warehouse-scoped job cards for repair, service, refurbishment and controlled manufacturing work.
value_points: Runs quote approval, labour, evidence, linked costs and job progress in one focused workspace
Includes unlimited named JobIQ users and warehouses within the organisation; normal plan limits still apply to connected invoices and purchases
Manufacturing actions appear only when the base plan also includes BOM & Manufacturing and the user has InventoryIQ access

forecasting_intelligence_pack.name: Forecasting Intelligence Pack
forecasting_intelligence_pack.description: ForecastIQ planning intelligence for demand trends, stock risk, reorder planning, cash impact, and forward-looking operational decisions.
value_points: Turns live stock and sales history into reorder and risk signals
Helps buyers prevent stockouts, dead stock, and cash tied up in the wrong products

ecom_pack.name: Ecom Pack
ecom_pack.description: EcomIQ marketplace and web-store automation for product sync, order flow, cart events, and ecommerce visibility.
value_points: Connects ecommerce demand back into operational stock and invoice workflows
Reduces manual order and catalogue handling across online channels

brandiq_addon.name: BrandIQ
brandiq_addon.description: Brand strategy, Growth Signals, content workflows, campaign management, publishing connections, attribution and Agency HQ.
value_points: Runs as a focused growth workspace without requiring the client to replace its existing ERP
Connects approved campaigns to measurable leads, sales, revenue and return on spend

messaging_pack.name: Messaging Pack
messaging_pack.description: WhatsApp Web and WhatsApp API workflow activation. Meta/BSP conversation and API fees remain billed separately.
value_points: Adds customer messaging where invoice, quote, and follow-up work already happens
Keeps the FlowIQ platform fee low while external WhatsApp fees remain transparent

posiq_till_integration_pack.name: POSIQ Till Integration Pack
posiq_till_integration_pack.description: POSIQ till/POS integration for one store location, including provider webhooks, queue/retry, mapping review, up to two terminals, and the CashIQ shift cash-balancing bridge.
value_points: Connects till sales into FlowIQ without slowing the counter
Keeps cash-up, invoice, stock, and accounting automation gated until mappings are approved

payroll_pack.name: PayrollIQ
payroll_pack.description: Complete PayrollIQ payroll, leave, tax, payslip, employee self-service, and accounting handover for up to 5 active employees. Add more active employees for R20 each per month.
value_points: Includes all PayrollIQ features and employee self-service for up to 5 active employees
Scales simply at R20 per additional active employee; inactive and terminated employees do not count

business_units.name: Business Units
business_units.description: Unlimited internal subsidiaries, divisions, branches, brands, and cost centres inside one legal company.
value_points: Adds a clean internal structure without creating separate FlowIQ companies
Sets the foundation for unit-level payroll, expenses, invoices, and reporting

projectsiq_addon.name: ProjectsIQ Starter
projectsiq_addon.description: ProjectsIQ project control room for contractors and builders, capped at 25 active projects per year.
value_points: Up to 25 active projects per year with project P&L, cost allocation, claims, BOQs, snags, site photos, ledgers, and live profitability
Keeps InvoiceIQ, PurchaseIQ, SlipIQ, and AI Capture as source-of-truth flows while ProjectsIQ shows the true project result
Good for smaller contractors that need proper project control without a heavy project system

projectsiq_growth.name: ProjectsIQ Growth
projectsiq_growth.description: ProjectsIQ for growing contractors, capped at 75 active projects per year.
value_points: Up to 75 active projects per year for larger teams running more sites or maintenance jobs
Includes the contractor workflows: BOQ/budget control, progress claims, site items, snag photos, and project ledgers
Keeps product, invoice, slip, purchase, landed-cost, and site cost allocations visible in ProjectsIQ

projectsiq_unlimited.name: ProjectsIQ Unlimited
projectsiq_unlimited.description: ProjectsIQ for high-volume contractors that need unlimited active projects per year.
value_points: Unlimited active projects per year for larger contractor groups and multi-site operations
Includes the full contractor control room with BOQs, claims, snags, photos, ledgers, and live project profitability
Best fit when project volume and document/photo storage will grow materially

projectsiq_storage_20gb.name: ProjectsIQ Media Pack
projectsiq_storage_20gb.description: Adds 20GB of ProjectsIQ media storage for snag photos, site evidence, drawings, and project documents.
value_points: Expands ProjectsIQ media storage without changing the project-count tier
Useful for contractors uploading many snag photos, site photos, drawings, and evidence files
Keeps storage costs transparent before high-volume projects eat into margin

bankingiq_addon.name: BankingIQ
bankingiq_addon.description: A complete multi-bank finance control room for bank accounts and statements, supplier, payroll, statutory and once-off payment preparation, saved beneficiaries, maker-checker approvals, scheduled queues, automated reconciliation, anomaly monitoring, cash-flow intelligence, and a complete audit trail.
value_points: Prepare supplier, payroll, SARS, and once-off payments from the correct bank account with saved beneficiaries, per-payment authorization, scheduling, batch queues, status tracking, and proof-ready history
Reconcile faster with statement imports, suggested matches, safe automation, bulk confidence review, multi-document allocations, and clear exception handling
Monitor bank balances, cash-flow pressure, unusual activity, and every approval, release, settlement, and reconciliation event in one auditable workspace
Direct bank feeds and payment execution require a separately approved and configured provider connection; provider charges remain separate

commission_rebate_automation_pack.name: Commission & Rebate Automation Pack
commission_rebate_automation_pack.description: Automates commission, rebate, and settlement workflows so teams do not manually reconcile customer rebates and representative commission logic.
value_points: Removes recurring manual rebate and commission reconciliation work
Keeps settlement and rebate automation tied to the live invoice/customer data

rfid_stock_tracking_pack.name: RFID Stock Tracking Pack
rfid_stock_tracking_pack.description: RFID tag code generation, label batch exports, reader evidence, stocktake scan foundation, transfer proof, and factory exit controls. Hardware, tags, and installation are billed separately.
value_points: Adds fast stocktake and physical movement evidence without replacing InventoryIQ stock controls
Keeps RFID reads review-gated so FIFO, transfers, invoices, and accounting are not auto-changed by noisy reads
Supports handheld readers first and fixed dock-door or factory-exit readers after site testing

value_points: Up to 25 active projects per year with project P&L, cost allocation, claims, BOQs, snags, site photos, ledgers, and live profitability
Keeps InvoiceIQ, PurchaseIQ, SlipIQ, and AI Capture as source-of-truth flows while ProjectsIQ shows the true project result
Good for smaller contractors that need proper project control without a heavy project system

projectsiq_growth.name: ProjectsIQ Growth
projectsiq_growth.description: ProjectsIQ for growing contractors, capped at 75 active projects per year.
value_points: Up to 75 active projects per year for larger teams running more sites or maintenance jobs
Includes the contractor workflows: BOQ/budget control, progress claims, site items, snag photos, and project ledgers
Keeps product, invoice, slip, purchase, landed-cost, and site cost allocations visible in ProjectsIQ

projectsiq_unlimited.name: ProjectsIQ Unlimited
projectsiq_unlimited.description: ProjectsIQ for high-volume contractors that need unlimited active projects per year.
value_points: Unlimited active projects per year for larger contractor groups and multi-site operations
Includes the full contractor control room with BOQs, claims, snags, photos, ledgers, and live project profitability
Best fit when project volume and document/photo storage will grow materially

projectsiq_storage_20gb.name: ProjectsIQ Media Pack
projectsiq_storage_20gb.description: Adds 20GB of ProjectsIQ media storage for snag photos, site evidence, drawings, and project documents.
value_points: Expands ProjectsIQ media storage without changing the project-count tier
Useful for contractors uploading many snag photos, site photos, drawings, and evidence files
Keeps storage costs transparent before high-volume projects eat into margin

bankingiq_addon.name: BankingIQ
bankingiq_addon.description: A complete multi-bank finance control room for bank accounts and statements, supplier, payroll, statutory and once-off payment preparation, saved beneficiaries, maker-checker approvals, scheduled queues, automated reconciliation, anomaly monitoring, cash-flow intelligence, and a complete audit trail.
value_points: Prepare supplier, payroll, SARS, and once-off payments from the correct bank account with saved beneficiaries, per-payment authorization, scheduling, batch queues, status tracking, and proof-ready history
Reconcile faster with statement imports, suggested matches, safe automation, bulk confidence review, multi-document allocations, and clear exception handling
Monitor bank balances, cash-flow pressure, unusual activity, and every approval, release, settlement, and reconciliation event in one auditable workspace
Direct bank feeds and payment execution require a separately approved and configured provider connection; provider charges remain separate

commission_rebate_automation_pack.name: Commission & Rebate Automation Pack
commission_rebate_automation_pack.description: Automates commission, rebate, and settlement workflows so teams do not manually reconcile customer rebates and representative commission logic.
value_points: Removes recurring manual rebate and commission reconciliation work
Keeps settlement and rebate automation tied to the live invoice/customer data

rfid_stock_tracking_pack.name: RFID Stock Tracking Pack
rfid_stock_tracking_pack.description: RFID tag code generation, label batch exports, reader evidence, stocktake scan foundation, transfer proof, and factory exit controls. Hardware, tags, and installation are billed separately.
value_points: Adds fast stocktake and physical movement evidence without replacing InventoryIQ stock controls
Keeps RFID reads review-gated so FIFO, transfers, invoices, and accounting are not auto-changed by noisy reads
Supports handheld readers first and fixed dock-door or factory-exit readers after site testing

professional.name: Professional
professional.tagline: More users, more warehouses, clean expansion path

extra_users.name: Extra User Seat
extra_users.description: Add one additional team member without forcing a full plan upgrade.
value_points: Keeps daily users inside the same live workspace
Useful when operations teams grow before SKU or warehouse limits do

extra_skus.name: Extra SKU Capacity
value_points: Keeps inventory, costing, purchasing, and sales history in one system
Buys more catalogue headroom without paying for unused warehouses

extra_shipments.name: Extra Import/Export Jobs
value_points: Adds freight workflow volume without changing the whole plan
Good for seasonal import/export peaks

agentsiq_usage_pack.name: AI Pack
agentsiq_usage_pack.description: AI Pack: 100 capture credits shared with AI Automation Suite capture and AgentsIQ workflows
value_points: Recurring monthly AI credit allowance for capture and agent usage
Lets customers scale AI usage in small, predictable increments

trade_portal.name: Trade Portal
trade_portal.description: A secure self-service ordering portal where customers see their approved products, live pricing and permitted stock availability, then submit orders directly into InvoiceIQ.
value_points: Lets customers place accurate orders from their assigned price list without waiting for a quote
Keeps customer access, stock visibility, documents and order progress safely controlled by the supplier
Includes unlimited customer companies and portal users for one FlowIQ organisation

ai_auto_capture.name: AI Automation Suite
ai_auto_capture.description: AI Automation Suite for document capture, slip capture, import capture, SalesIQ voice transcription, and AgentsIQ proactive workflows with 150 monthly capture credits.
value_points: Turns invoices, purchase orders, supplier bills, slips, import documents, and voice notes into review-ready drafts
Includes AgentsIQ proactive checks and follow-up workflows while preserving human review before posting or action

jobiq_addon.name: JobIQ
jobiq_addon.description: Warehouse-scoped job cards for repair, service, refurbishment and controlled manufacturing work.
value_points: Runs quote approval, labour, evidence, linked costs and job progress in one focused workspace
Includes unlimited named JobIQ users and warehouses within the organisation; normal plan limits still apply to connected invoices and purchases
Manufacturing actions appear only when the base plan also includes BOM & Manufacturing and the user has InventoryIQ access

forecasting_intelligence_pack.name: Forecasting Intelligence Pack
forecasting_intelligence_pack.description: ForecastIQ planning intelligence for demand trends, stock risk, reorder planning, cash impact, and forward-looking operational decisions.
value_points: Turns live stock and sales history into reorder and risk signals
Helps buyers prevent stockouts, dead stock, and cash tied up in the wrong products

ecom_pack.name: Ecom Pack
ecom_pack.description: EcomIQ marketplace and web-store automation for product sync, order flow, cart events, and ecommerce visibility.
value_points: Connects ecommerce demand back into operational stock and invoice workflows
Reduces manual order and catalogue handling across online channels

brandiq_addon.name: BrandIQ
brandiq_addon.description: Brand strategy, Growth Signals, content workflows, campaign management, publishing connections, attribution and Agency HQ.
value_points: Runs as a focused growth workspace without requiring the client to replace its existing ERP
Connects approved campaigns to measurable leads, sales, revenue and return on spend

messaging_pack.name: Messaging Pack
messaging_pack.description: WhatsApp Web and WhatsApp API workflow activation. Meta/BSP conversation and API fees remain billed separately.
value_points: Adds customer messaging where invoice, quote, and follow-up work already happens
Keeps the FlowIQ platform fee low while external WhatsApp fees remain transparent

posiq_till_integration_pack.name: POSIQ Till Integration Pack
posiq_till_integration_pack.description: POSIQ till/POS integration for one store location, including provider webhooks, queue/retry, mapping review, up to two terminals, and the CashIQ shift cash-balancing bridge.
value_points: Connects till sales into FlowIQ without slowing the counter
Keeps cash-up, invoice, stock, and accounting automation gated until mappings are approved

payroll_pack.name: PayrollIQ
payroll_pack.description: Complete PayrollIQ payroll, leave, tax, payslip, employee self-service, and accounting handover for up to 5 active employees. Add more active employees for R20 each per month.
value_points: Includes all PayrollIQ features and employee self-service for up to 5 active employees
Scales simply at R20 per additional active employee; inactive and terminated employees do not count

business_units.name: Business Units
business_units.description: Unlimited internal subsidiaries, divisions, branches, brands, and cost centres inside one legal company.
value_points: Adds a clean internal structure without creating separate FlowIQ companies
Sets the foundation for unit-level payroll, expenses, invoices, and reporting
